votes.motion: Commissioner Russell moved to approve the minutes from the June 11, 2024 Planning Commission meeting as presented

Commissioner McElreath moved to approve File #17C24 / CUP-000465- 2024, a request for a conditional use permit to operate a reception center with extended hours of operation at 4870 South Redwood Road, adding a 12th condition that the rear door was to remain closed, and all attendees were to remain inside the building during events

Commissioner Quigley moved to separate Agenda Item #5 into two separate issues: 1) microschools and micro education entities; 2) the amendments related to vehicles and trailers Associated with a home occupation

Commissioner Wendel moved to forward a negative recommendation to the City Council regarding consideration of a zoning text amendment to several sections of the Taylorsville Municipal Code to align city standards to Utah Senate Bill 13 related to home-based micro schools and micro education entities

Commissioner Quigley moved to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council on 2Z24/DCA-000435-2024 regarding home-based microschools and micro-education entities, but to stress the Planning Commission’s concern regarding the state legislature’s continued overreach and ask that the City Council consider those concerns when the matter was before them. The motion died for lack of a second
Commissioner Wendel moved to table File #2Z24/DCA-000435-2024 (regarding home-based microschools and micro-education entities) to the August 13, 2024 Planning Commission meeting

Commissioner Quigley moved to forward a negative recommendation to City Council regarding File #2Z24/DCA-000435-2024B to amend the Taylorsville Municipal Code related to Vehicles and Trailers Associated with a Home Occupation
